title: Israeli Strikes Kill 8 in Nuseirat, Khan Younis, and Gaza City in 24 Hours
detail: A drone strike on Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza killed 2 Palestinians. A strike on a home courtyard in the Batn as-Sameen area of Khan Younis killed 2 more. A strike on a busy Gaza City street killed 1 person. The Gaza Ministry of Health reported at least 8 killed and 17 wounded over the 24-hour period, part of a sustained pattern of near-daily strikes since the October 2025 ceasefire.

media.caption: Aftermath of Israeli strikes across Gaza that killed 8 in 24 hours — July 9, 2026

title: ~150 Israeli Settlers Storm Deir Jarir Village East of Ramallah, Set Home Alight
detail: Around 150 Israeli settlers attacked the Palestinian village of Deir Jarir, next to the Christian town of Taybeh east of Ramallah, converging from four directions and blocking the main entrance. Settlers set a Palestinian home on fire and assaulted residents who tried to intervene, while Israeli forces blocked ambulances from reaching the wounded. It was the third such assault on the village in 2026, following an April shooting death of resident Ali Hamadneh by a settler on reserve duty and a May attack that wounded residents.

media.caption: Israeli settlers storm Deir Jarir village east of Ramallah, injuring residents — July 9, 2026
